parameters.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),crypto=require("crypto");const CONTROL="/home/node/.n8n-files/control";const REQUEST=CONTROL+"/production_handoff.request.json";const RESPONSE=CONTROL+"/production_handoff.response.json";const SCHEMA="quant-control-action/v1";const RESPONSE_SCHEMA="quant-control-action-response/v1";const ACTION="production_handoff_once";const REQUEST_ID="n8n-"+crypto.randomUUID();const payload=JSON.stringify({schema:SCHEMA,action:ACTION,request_id:REQUEST_ID});const tmp=CONTROL+"/.production_handoff.request."+process.pid+"."+crypto.randomUUID()+".tmp";const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise((resolve)=>setTimeout(resolve,ms));const fail=(message)=>{process.stderr.write(message+"\n");process.exit(1);};(async()=>{let fd=null;try{fs.mkdirSync(CONTROL,{recursive:true});fd=fs.openSync(tmp,"wx",0o600);fs.writeFileSync(fd,payload,{encoding:"utf8"});fs.fsyncSync(fd);fs.closeSync(fd);fd=null;try{fs.linkSync(tmp,REQUEST);}finally{try{fs.unlinkSync(tmp);}catch{}}}catch(error){if(fd!==null)try{fs.closeSync(fd);}catch{};try{fs.unlinkSync(tmp);}catch{};fail("request_publish_failed: "+error.message);}const deadline=Date.now()+615000;while(Date.now()<deadline){let response=null;try{const stat=fs.lstatSync(RESPONSE);if(!stat.isFile()||stat.isSymbolicLink())throw new Error("response_not_regular");response=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(RESPONSE,"utf8"));}catch{}if(response&&response.schema===RESPONSE_SCHEMA&&response.request_id===REQUEST_ID&&response.action===ACTION){process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(response)+"\n");return;}await sleep(250);}fail(JSON.stringify({schema:RESPONSE_SCHEMA,request_id:REQUEST_ID,action:ACTION,status:"response_timeout"}));})().catch((error)=>fail("request_response_failed: "+error.message));'
